title: Phase gating and human-approval enforcement via hooks
statement: Phase gating and human-approval enforcement via hooks
body: - Phase is a field in `harness/policy/command-policy.json`. In Phase 0 the hook denies writes to application and IaC paths and any Azure mutation. - Approvals are not stored in a file agents can write. A human approves by setting an ADR to `Accepted` and by editing the control-plane files, which the hook marks as requiring approval. - Hook, policy, workflows and recorder scripts are control-plane: agent edits need a human decision.
subject: adr.0002
